text:
jessica_sales: Anne at DeltaSurge reports our streaming demo keeps dropping mid-response, they see JSON parse errors in the webview.
anne_customer: sorry, attaching logs — the client shows truncated payloads e.g. '{"choices": ["part...'. Happens ~30–60s into the stream, sometimes multiple times.
ojmal_customer (typo)
omar_se: thanks Anne — can you paste the raw network frames or a HAR? is this in their webview or native app?
anne_customer: webview (Android), I attached a small HAR to the ticket: https://files.example/deltasurge-har-03.zip
omar_se: ok looking — I see SSE events arriving but some events end abruptly with no final "

" and payloads split across frames. Client's JSON parser throws on the partial chunk.
liam_infra: possible culprits: upstream proxy buffering or the Android WebView pulling bytes mid-chunk. Any reverse proxy (Cloudflare/NGINX) in front?
anne_customer: they use an internal edge proxy + our SDK in the webview. No CDN.
kate_e2e: re reproducer steps I saw earlier — when server-side rate limiting or connection backpressure kicks in, we end up flushing half of a structured event. We had a bug in the SSE writer where flush() could be called before writing the trailing newlines.
nick_support: can you paste a minimal example of the SSE frames? even a few lines helps.
omar_se: asking engineering to dump raw frames. liam, can you check if any recent runtime change touched chunking/flush behavior?
liam_infra: checking commit history... there was a micro-optimizer that changed buffered I/O around 2026-02-18, it toggles auto-flush after N tokens. Could explain cutting a single "data:" block mid-body.
liam_infra: quick workaround for them: set proxy_buffering off (if using nginx) OR ensure Transfer-Encoding: chunked is preserved end-to-end and disable intermediate proxies from re-chunking. Also recommend client-side reassembly: accumulate until a full JSON object (matching braces) before parse.
omar_se: for the SDK/webview team, add a small tolerant parser that buffers partial messages; that should unblock POC quickly.
anne_customer: can you confirm if this will require changes on our side? dev time is limited.
jessica_sales: DeltaSurge asked about switching to Dedicated capacity to avoid edge proxying and rate-based throttles — what's the timeline and cost ballpark?
liam_infra: Dedicated will avoid shared rate-limiting and allow stable long-lived connections; onboarding usually 2–3 weeks for reserved pools, pricing is in the enterprise quote but we can give a short-term elevated quota while we triage.
nick_support: short-term support plan: 1) apply tolerance buffering in webview (client) — low effort, 1 engineer-day. 2) we push a runtime rollback or disable the auto-flush optimizer — infra task, 1–2 days. 3) if they want immediate reliability, open a Dedicated trial.
omar_se: I can ship a patch to the SDK with buffering logic and a quick example that matches SSE semantics (buffer until you hit "

" or a complete JSON). Will also add a diagnostics header so we can correlate truncated frames: X-Debug-SSE: true.
liam_infra: I'll instrument the runtime and add logs: "SSE_WRITE_START id=%s len=%d flushed=%b" so we can see where flushes happen.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/runtime-rollback @liam_infra requested — ETA 18m
omer typo
nick_support: Anne, can we get a contact who can deploy the client-side change and test? If they prefer, we can supply a prebuilt patch.
anne_customer: I can get dev Paul to apply the SDK patch tomorrow morning PST.
omar_se: good. Also: advise them to set HTTP keepalive timeouts longer than 90s and disable any mobile network proxies that re-chunk streaming responses.
jessica_sales: I'll follow up on the Dedicated pricing/quote and mention the short-term elevated quota. Also will flag SOC2/compliance Qs — they asked about private deployment options.
liam_infra: for completeness: SSE spec requires event blocks terminated with a blank line. Our producer should never emit partial event terminators. We'll revert optimizer and write a unit test for chunk boundaries.
nick_support: assign follow-ups: @omar_se provide SDK patch (PR link once ready), @liam_infra runtime rollback + logs, @jessica_sales pricing/quote, customer to test client patch.
omar_se: attaching small patch snippet for client-side reassembly:```js
let buffer = '';
resp.on('data', chunk => { buffer += chunk; while (buffer.includes('

')) { let idx = buffer.indexOf('

'); let event = buffer.slice(0, idx).trim(); buffer = buffer.slice(idx + 2); // process event lines
 // extract data: lines and parse JSON
 } });
```
kate_e2e: will add an e2e test that simulates truncated frames and ensures client reassembly works.
anne_customer: appreciate the quick triage, team. We'll try the SDK patch tomorrow and report results.
jessica_sales: thanks all — looping in account exec for follow-up. :thumbsup:
